$comment: S13 NASA GIBS satellite imagery (T066). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s13.yaml.

fields.name: imagery_date
fields.meaning: newest date listed in the layer's Time ranges whose tile over the state is not blank; shown on the map

fields.name: bounds
fields.meaning: WGS84BoundingBox lower and upper corners: lon lat lon lat

source_url: the probed tile that proved the date has imagery over the state
blank: a tile whose pixels are all black (grey level 8 or less) is no imagery; white cloud is imagery
